output.title: Refund policy — duplicate charges
output.content: Duplicate charges caused by a billing system error are refunded automatically within 5 business days. No ticket is required, but you're welcome to ask support to confirm a specific refund is in progress.

output.title: Refund policy — subscription cancellation
output.content: You can cancel your subscription at any time from Account Settings > Billing. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period. We do not issue partial refunds for unused days in the current period.

output.title: Upgrading from Free to Pro plan
output.content: Upgrade from Account Settings > Billing > Change Plan. The Pro plan is billed immediately on a prorated basis for the remainder of your current billing cycle, then at the full rate from the next cycle onward.

steps.rawOutput:
Thank you for reaching out about this. I sincerely apologize for the frustration caused by the duplicate charge.

According to our policy, duplicate charges caused by a billing system error are automatically refunded within 5 business days. You've now been waiting 8 business days, which exceeds that window. I understand why this is concerning.

I'd like to help you locate this refund. To investigate what happened with your refund, I'll need some additional information:

- Your account email address or customer ID
- The date(s) of the duplicate charges
- The amount charged
- The payment method used (credit card, debit card, etc.)

Once I have these details, I can confirm the status of your refund and determine next steps. It's possible the refund was issued but is still in transit to your bank depending on your financial institution's processing times, but I want to verify this directly for you.

Please reply with this information at your earliest convenience so I can investigate right away.
